verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-facing way to define or schedule recurring jobs or workflows, whether in the app or through the API. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: Harbor files annual reports automatically as they come due, which is a vendor-run managed service, and users can customize annual-report reminders, which are notifications rather than scheduled workflows. The API docs cover authentication, rate limits and idempotency only, with no scheduling endpoints.
